The zuslothdb driver

Source: R/driver.R
zuslothdb.Rd

A DBI driver for the bundled SlothDB engine. The driver holds one database, in memory or in a file, which every connection made from it shares, as duckdb::duckdb() does. The database opens at the first DBI::dbConnect() and closes with its last connection.

Usage

zuslothdb(dbdir = ":memory:", read_only = FALSE)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_driver'
show(object)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_driver'
dbIsValid(dbObj, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_driver'
dbGetInfo(dbObj, ...)

Arguments

dbdir

":memory:" (the default) for an in-memory database, or the path of a database file. The file need not exist unless read_only is TRUE; its directory must.

read_only

TRUE to refuse every statement that would change the database, and never write its file.

object

A zuslothdb_driver.

dbObj

A zuslothdb_driver.

...

Not used.

Value

An object of class zuslothdb_driver, for DBI::dbConnect().

Details

A file-backed database is read into memory when it opens and written back, whole, when it closes: through DBI::dbDisconnect() of its last connection, or at the end of the R session. The file is tied to the engine commit that zuslothdb_info() reports.

See also

DBI::dbConnect(), whose zuslothdb method takes threads.

Examples

drv <- zuslothdb()
con <- DBI::dbConnect(drv)
DBI::dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE t (x INTEGER)")
#> [1] 0
DBI::dbExecute(con, "INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2)")
#> [1] 2
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
